question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can logically replace the question mark (?) in the following series 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf9ee5c01cc513032001ce31f38863ed69db946cfdda0ef64073396f9dd8f97f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c29369c4a8b4e84658e730bd11219ad0418818faac7716b57ae5e22a01e0620.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The symbols are moving in clockwise direction along the corners.

After reaching the top left corner, the symbols move in the centre and then to the top right corner in the subsequent images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27ea5fd1b5dbfaad371f9f6b87e1709be2781b794e30d716ac0b25e73e6ceb6c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/707f2f848ccd950eb09089ce2530d1707c31dae62e6ee37743b573320a744200.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
